improverSessionTargetDto.description: Exact current Improve-with-agent target provenance. It enables target-specific Session reuse and is neither Session parentage nor launch authority.

targetId.description: Worker, Routine, run configuration, or new-run kind identity; null for Project Steward instructions and the Project Playbook Builder.

ask_to_source_session_id.description: Exact source Session for a current Ask-To helper presentation relationship; null for every unrelated Session. This current provenance survives restart but is not generic Session parentage, history, or authority.

fork_source_session_id.description: Exact source Session for a current native fork presentation relationship; null when this Session is not a fork. This is a runtime projection only and does not grant parentage, lifecycle, or authority.

run_configuration_id.description: Run configuration this Terminal Session was started from; null for every Session that is not a run. Current provenance for projection grouping, never Session parentage or history.

improver_target.description: Exact current target for an Improve-with-agent Session; null for every unrelated Session. Optional only so older daemon projections remain readable during additive rollout.

deletedSessionDto.description: One closed Agent retained in the 30-day recycle bin. Restore remains Core-owned and requires the original source directory.

content.description: Complete inspectable launch content. The bound includes the largest valid Routine Builder inventory plus its visible authored prompt.

delivered_content.description: Complete content delivered through this launch transport. It is never truncated because the inspector and execution payload project the same manifest.

systemPrompt.description: Optional Project-specific instructions appended to TermLoop's protected Steward runtime and delivered through the selected provider's native instruction channel.

initialPrompt.description: The exact visible activation message TermLoop will deliver as terminal input on the assistant's next launch.

instructionsPrompt.description: The exact visible TermLoop instructions delivered through the selected provider's native instruction channel.

protectedPrompt.description: The visible built-in runtime and safety portion of instructionsPrompt. It is inspectable but not editable.

wakePrompt.description: The exact visible ordinary wake message TermLoop delivers when this persistent assistant is activated.

systemPrompt.description: Optional Project-specific instructions appended to the protected Steward runtime.

pingIntervalSeconds.description: How often TermLoop visibly wakes an idle ready Worker to check its due Routine queue.

workerPrompt.description: Editable Routine-handling instructions composed after the protected built-in Worker runtime.

systemPrompt.description: Editable general Worker behavior instructions. These take precedence over workerPrompt but cannot replace the protected built-in runtime.

workingDirectory.description: Directory the run starts in, relative to the Task worktree root. "." runs at the root; the resolved directory must stay inside the worktree.

assistantPromptSurface.description: Which visible Project surface a target-bound version-writing Agent is allowed to edit.

settingsImproverTargetKind.description: Which application-settings catalog an Improve-with-agent launch is aimed at.

settingsImproverTarget.description: The closed selector for one settings entry: a skill by catalog id, a prompt by asset id, or an MCP tool by name. The improver Session reaches this entry and no other.

name.description: Client-supplied display name, for the prompt catalog only. The daemon resolves a skill and an MCP tool itself and refuses a value here.

path.description: Client-supplied absolute path of the file that backs a prompt catalog entry. Null for the kinds the daemon resolves itself.

content.description: Client-supplied current text of a prompt catalog entry. Null for the kinds the daemon reads itself.

settingsImproveParams.description: Inspects the Improve-with-agent launch for one settings entry. The daemon composes the delivered instructions from the visible template and the entry's current stored value; the caller supplies no prompt text. After user confirmation in chat, the improver applies the entry's normal configuration command and records a new active snapshot only when the effective content changed.

assistantPromptImproverTarget.description: The closed selector for one agent-assisted Project surface. Steward instructions and Playbook belong to the Project and carry no owner; a Worker's and a Routine's instructions each name theirs. The daemon refuses a request that fills the wrong slot.

ownerId.description: The Worker or Routine whose prompt this is, or null for Project-owned Steward instructions and Playbook.

assistantPromptImproveParams.description: Inspects the Improve-with-agent launch for one editable assistant prompt. The delivered instructions are composed by the daemon from the visible template, the built-in part the agent may not change, and the prompt's current stored value; the caller supplies no prompt text.

runConfigurationImproveParams.description: Inspects the Improve-with-agent launch for one run configuration. The delivered instructions are composed by the daemon from the visible template and the configuration's current stored value; the caller supplies no prompt text.

runConfigurationImproverTarget.description: What an Improve-with-agent flow is aimed at. Exactly one slot is non-null: an existing configuration to edit, or the kind of a configuration this Project does not have yet. The daemon refuses a request that fills both or neither.

forceSetup.description: Chain the setup command into this launch even when the current once-per-worktree mark says setup already completed.
Chain the setup command into this launch even when the current once-per-checkout mark says setup already completed.

taskId.description: Current Task projection for this runtime slot, or null when the run was started in the Project's own checkout. Either way this does not make the Session a Task child.

prompt.description: Optional complete Worker observation instructions for an agent-built Routine. Omitted creates use the kind's built-in instructions.

stewardInstructions.description: Optional Steward response policy for an agent-built Routine.
